name: @codex-to-dsh/codex-archive
description: Read a Codex home read-only and write a portable, verifiable, self-describing archive
//: Zero build. Sources are plain ESM under src/; there is no dist/ and no compile step. The repository convention is zero-build ESM, and this package needs nothing compiled: node:fs, node:crypto, node:zlib and node:test are the whole dependency set. engines>=22.15.0 is required for the built-in zstd; detectCompression() degrades to no compression and records that in the manifest rather than silently substituting another format.
